bugs.error_message: contract-price pipeline never ran end-to-end in Docker: skill CLI subprocess died on import (ModuleNotFoundError) and UI 'Run pipeline' silently failed
bugs.root_cause: service.run_pipeline_subprocess spawned the CLI with bare 'python'. The gateway PID-1 env PATH has NO .venv/bin (uv runs uvicorn via the venv binary's shebang, not via PATH), so bare 'python' resolved to the container SYSTEM python (/usr/local/bin/python) which has zero pipeline deps (no sqlalchemy/asyncpg/httpx/numpy/xlsxwriter). Initial misdiagnosis blamed a missing sklearn, but sklearn is deliberately excluded — clustering is numpy-only (engine.py/vectorizer.py reimplement DBSCAN+TF-IDF to avoid scipy) and the venv already has every dep the pipeline needs.
bugs.fix: Changed subprocess cmd from "python" to sys.executable so the CLI runs under the same venv interpreter the gateway app runs under (the project venv, which has all deps). uvicorn --reload picked it up. Verified: `python -m scripts.cli --help` runs clean under /app/backend/.venv/bin/python. NO package install was needed.

bugs.error_message: contract-price pipeline failed: HTTPStatusError 404 from RAGFlow (http://eai-flow-ragflow:9380/datasets/.../documents) — every RAGFlow call 404'd, runs flaked (some completed-with-0-docs, some failed)

The 404 body was non-JSON so error handling was inconsistent (sometimes caught → completed 0 docs, sometimes httpx HTTPStatusError escaped → failed).

Durable code fix, takes effect on next run with no gateway restart, and tolerates any misconfigured env. Also corrected .env.docker:18 to include /api/v1. eai-flow-cad container crash-looped at startup: TypeError: FastMCP.run() got an unexpected keyword argument 'host'
bugs.root_cause: Patterned the FastMCP launch after Office-Word-MCP-Server (older mcp SDK), passing host/port/path to mcp.run(). In mcp 1.28 those are FastMCP() CONSTRUCTOR kwargs (run() only takes transport + mount_path). Default host is 127.0.0.1, so even after fixing run() the server would bind localhost and be unreachable from the gateway over the docker network.
bugs.fix: Pass host/port/streamable_http_path to the FastMCP('...', host='0.0.0.0', port=8003, streamable_http_path='/mcp') constructor; call mcp.run(transport='streamable-http') with no host/port. Inspect the installed API with `docker run --rm python -c "import inspect; from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP; print(inspect.signature(FastMCP.run)); print(inspect.signature(FastMCP.__init__))"` rather than copying another server's launch code.

bugs.error_message: cad Docker image build hung 7+ min with no output; pip crawled pypi.org (8s timeout, only 324KB of 1.6MB ezdxf index delivered)
bugs.root_cause: pypi.org is slow/unreachable from this dev network. The Dockerfile pip-installs ezdxf/matplotlib/mcp with no index override; default PIP_INDEX_URL=pypi.org. The backend Dockerfile uses uv with UV_INDEX_URL for the same reason, but .env does NOT set UV_INDEX_URL, so any pip-based image build stalls.
bugs.fix: Build with a mirror: `UV_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple docker compose -p eai-docker -f docker/docker-compose-dev.yaml up -d --build cad` (28s install vs stall). The cad Dockerfile + compose already thread PIP_INDEX_URL=${UV_INDEX_URL:-https://pypi.org/simple}. Tsinghua mirror measured 1.9s vs pypi 8s+. Recommend setting UV_INDEX_URL permanently in .env (gateway/backend builds need it too).

bugs.error_message: POST /api/extensions/knowledge-bases/{id}/documents 返回 403 Forbidden — 模板抽取对话框上传 Word 文件失败
bugs.root_cause: 权限有两套表：roles.permissions 数组（实际生效）和 role_permissions 表（项目角色）。初次修复误 INSERT 到 role_permissions 表的 owner 行，但认证中间件 require_permission 检查的是 roles.permissions 数组。session 用户 lisi 的 project_manager 角色该数组缺少 kb:upload。
bugs.fix: UPDATE roles SET permissions = array_append(permissions, 'kb:upload') WHERE code = 'project_manager'。变更后用户需重新登录刷新 session 缓存的权限。
